components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's one main action: teal gradient, teal glow, 1px hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-primary, #0f766e), var(--color-primary-strong, #115e59)); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 13px var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.26); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Toolbar and header actions on cream raised fill with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fffaf2); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9cfbe); color: var(--color-text, #1f2937); border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 13px var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #c5b79e); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmations only — solid red ink with red glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--color-danger, #b91c1c); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 16px; font: 600 13px var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #a11818; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.26); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised cream field with hairline border; teal border + 4px ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fffaf2); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9cfbe); color: var(--color-text, #1f2937); border-radius: 12px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 400 13px var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); min-height: 34px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft, 0 10px 24px rgba(31,41,55,0.08)); transition: border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted, #667085); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); }

components.name: Account Chip — Mapped
components.description: Per-row account status in teal tint; pencil glyph fades in on hover to advertise editability.
components.css: .ds-chip-ok { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.22); color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 8px; font: 700 11.5px/1.2 var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-chip-ok:hover { background: rgba(15, 118, 110, 0.16); } .ds-chip-ok:hover .ds-chip-edit { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip-edit { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 140ms ease; } .ds-chip-ok:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.description: Unmapped or mixed account: amber tint pill marking a pending human decision.

components.name: Group Chip
components.description: Attention-queue group tab: status dot, label, mono count, chevron.
components.css: .ds-group-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d9cfbe); background: var(--color-surface-muted, #f4ede2); color: var(--color-text, #1f2937); font: 600 12.5px var(--font-sans, Manrope, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-group-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #c5b79e); } .ds-group-chip--open { background: var(--color-surface-raised, #fffaf2); border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #c5b79e); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-accent, #b45309); } .ds-count { color: var(--color-text-muted, #667085); font-weight: 500; } .ds-group-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring, rgba(15,118,110,0.18)); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
StatementX looks like a well-kept accounting ledger lying on a warm wooden desk. The ground is warm parchment washed with faint amber and teal radial glows; every working surface is a paper card ruled with one-pixel hairlines, the way a ledger page is ruled. Color behaves like a clerk's pens: teal ink does the confirming and the acting, amber ink flags anything that needs a human decision, red ink is reserved for destruction. Nothing shouts; density is comfortable, not cramped, because the users are mixed-skill bookkeeping staff, some not accountants by training.

The system is token-first: every color, radius, shadow, and font stack lives as a CSS custom property in admin_frontend/src/style.css with a parallel html.dark variant block, and Tailwind is configured to read those variables. Components never hardcode hex values; they compose tokens. UI copy mixes English and Indonesian naturally — numbers and dates always set in the mono voice so they read as ledger figures regardless of language.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with radial amber/teal washes; cream card surfaces with hairline borders
Dual-theme by CSS variables (:root light, html.dark dark) — no component knows which theme is active
Teal = action/confirm/mapped; amber = needs attention; red = destructive only
Manrope for the UI voice, IBM Plex Mono for every numeral a clerk scans
One-pixel hairline ruling between table cells and card sections
Soft ambient card shadows, always on; hover responses tint rows and lift buttons, never shadow-pop tables
Pill-shaped status chips built from ~10% alpha tints, not solid fills

rules.name: The Amber-Flags-Work Rule
rules.body: Teal means the system is acting or confirming; amber means a human must decide; red means something will be destroyed. A surface never borrows red for decoration or amber for success.

rules.name: The Tint-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Status chips and selection states are ~10% alpha tints with a ~22-24% alpha border and the solid token as text color — never solid color fills.

rules.name: The Numerals-in-Plex Rule
rules.body: Any figure a clerk compares — debit, credit, count, date, period — sets in IBM Plex Mono. Prose never intrudes on the numeric voice.

rules.name: The Ledger-Label Rule
rules.body: Column headers and toolbar labels are 10.5-11px, bold-to-extrabold, uppercase, letter-spaced, Pencil Gray. They are the ledger's printed column captions.

rules.name: The Rows-Tint-Cards-Lift Rule
rules.body: Table rows respond to hover with a background tint, never a shadow; buttons and cards may lift. A table that moves is a table that lies about being paper.

dos: Do take every color from the CSS variables in admin_frontend/src/style.css and add the dark variant in the html.dark block when introducing a token.
Do set every numeral, date, and amount in IBM Plex Mono (var(--font-mono)), right-aligned in table columns.
Do build data surfaces on the TableShell / SectionCard / PageHeader primitives, with hairline 1px --color-border ruling and 41-46px rows.
Do express status as tint chips: ~10% alpha fill, ~22-24% alpha border, solid token text.
Do use :focus-visible with 2px solid var(--color-primary-ring) outline (1px offset) on all custom controls, and honor prefers-reduced-motion for transitions.
Do write micro-labels as 10.5-11px bold uppercase with 0.08em tracking in Pencil Gray.
donts: Don't hardcode hex values or raw Tailwind palette classes (text-red-500) in components — the token layer is the only source.
Don't use red for anything that is not destructive, and don't use amber for success — amber is a pending decision, red is a destroyed row.
Don't put shadows or lifts on table rows; rows tint (4% teal), cards lift.
Don't invent a second accent or introduce solid-fill status colors — the tint-not-fill formula and the teal/amber/red division are the system.
Don't drop below ~10.5px for labels (the incumbent 9-10px table text is a known accessibility failure being corrected, not a precedent).
